mapper.select: SELECT RV.RECRUIT_VIEW_NO as RECRUIT_VIEW_NO , RV.USER_ID as USER_ID , RV.RECRUITMENT_NO as RECRUITMENT_NO , RV.VIEW_AT as VIEW_AT , RN.RECRUITMENT_TITLE as RECRUITMENT_TITLE , RN.RECRUITMENT_SALARY as RECRUITMENT_SALARY , RN.WELFARE as WELFARE , RN.CITY_CODE AS CITY_CODE , RN.DISTRICT_CODE AS DISTRICT_CODE , RN.YEAR_CODE AS YEAR_CODE , C.COM_NAME as COM_NAME FROM RECRUIT_VIEW RV LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RN ON RV.RECRUITMENT_NO = RN.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT JOIN COMPANY C ON C.USER_ID = RN.USER_ID WHERE RV.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY VIEW_AT
